subject: POC onboarding roadmap, success criteria & weekly check-ins
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Martinez <elena@pinebridge.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 02 May 2026 15:09:00 -0700
Subject: POC onboarding roadmap, success criteria & weekly check-ins

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposal so we have shared expectations for the trial:

Scope (what we’ll evaluate)
- Inference quality on your product-qa prompts (chat completions + extraction).
- Latency at 95th percentile for typical request sizes (see suggested traffic profile below).
- Integration ergonomics: API auth, rate limiting, and sample data ingestion.

Success criteria (proposal)
- Quality: >= 85% pass rate on your internal QA prompt set (we’ll run labeled evals).
- Latency: 95p < 250ms on dedicated 8k tokens/session distribution during daytime traffic.
- Operational: Token costs under your budget target (TBD in contract).

POC timeline (suggested)
- Week 0 (this week): Kickoff, access, network checklist, and test dataset delivery. (Owner: Pinebridge / Marcus for data, Redwood for access).
- Week 1: Integration + smoke tests; Redwood provides baseline runbook.
- Week 2: Full evaluation run (automated eval + manual spot-checks).
- Week 3: Wrap, results summary, go/no-go decision.

Ownership (who does what)
- Pinebridge: provide sample prompts/datasets, open network access, define final success metric threshold.
- Redwood: provide dedicated trial instance, run automated evals, provide weekly status report.

Next steps (please confirm these by EOD Monday)
1) Confirm kickoff window (we propose Tue 5/5 at 10:00 PT).
2) Share a secure link to the test payloads (or confirm SFTP details).
3) Complete the attached Network_Questionnaire.xlsx and return to me.

Attached: POC_Onboarding_Playbook.pdf (step-by-step), Network_Questionnaire.xlsx.

I’ll follow up mid-week with a short checklist and calendar invite.

Cheers,

--
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

From: Elena Martinez <elena@pinebridge.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Li <marcus.li@pinebridge.ai>, Jordan Patel <jordan.p@pinebridge.ai>
Date: Sun, 03 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC onboarding roadmap, success criteria & weekly check-ins

Thanks, Soojin — helpful summary. A few clarifications from our side:

- Quality metric: we can commit to the 85% pass-rate target for the labeled QA set, but would like one additional metric for extraction accuracy (F1 >= 0.82) if possible.
- Latency: 250ms 95p sounds reasonable; can you confirm whether that target assumes a cold model or warmed cache?
- Cost: we’ll need a rough estimate up front to model against our budget; a back-of-envelope for the three-week trial would be great.

On logistics:
- Kickoff: Tue 5/5 at 10:00 PT works for Marcus and me.
- Data: Marcus will share a secure S3 link with sample_payloads.tar.gz by EOD Monday.
- Network questionnaire: we’ll try to complete and return the spreadsheet by Monday afternoon.

Appreciate the playbook attachment — I’ll skim and flag anything major.

Best,
--
Elena Martinez
Head of Product | Pinebridge Robotics
elena@pinebridge.ai

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Martinez <elena@pinebridge.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 04 May 2026 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC onboarding roadmap, success criteria & weekly check-ins

Elena — thanks for the quick reply and for locking kickoff. Quick answers and additions: 

- Latency note: the 250ms 95p target assumes a warmed KV cache (typical of steady short sessions). We will include a cold-start run as part of the smoke tests and report both numbers.
- Extraction metric: we can add F1 >= 0.82 as a secondary success metric and include it in the final scorecard.
- Cost estimate: rough estimate for the three-week trial on a single dedicated lane (8 GPUs, typical batch) is $4.2k—this excludes any optional extended logging retention. Ben will follow up with a short breakout (I cc’d him).

Action items we’ll handle before kickoff:
- Redwood: provision trial instance, create test API keys, baseline runbook and automated eval harness. (Owner: Ben)
- Pinebridge: upload sample_payloads.tar.gz and return completed Network_Questionnaire.xlsx. (Owner: Marcus)

I’ve attached the network checklist again for visibility. See you Tue 5/5 10:00 PT (calendar invite to follow).

Thanks,

--
Soojin
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai

From: Marcus Li <marcus.li@pinebridge.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Elena Martinez <elena@pinebridge.ai>
Date: Wed, 06 May 2026 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC onboarding roadmap, success criteria & weekly check-ins

On Wed, May 4, 2026 at 08:17, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Elena — thanks for the quick reply and for locking kickoff. Quick answers and additions:
>
> - Latency note: the 250ms 95p target assumes a warmed KV cache (typical of steady short sessions). We will include a cold-start run as part of the smoke tests and report both numbers.

Thanks — that helps. We uploaded sample_payloads.tar.gz to the secure S3 link (s3://pinebridge-poc/sample_payloads.tar.gz) and shared IAM access with soojin@redwood.ai. The package includes: 
- 2k labeled QA prompts (JSONL)
- 500 manual test cases for edge extraction
- a small traffic replay file (1.1M tokens) for load staging

A couple of requests from my end: 
1) Can Redwood include a short latency test that simulates our peak batch pattern? I pasted the desired pattern below.
2) Who should we loop in for a brief network troubleshooting session if the questionnaire reveals blocked egress? (I recommend Ava as primary).

Proposed timeline update:
- Thu 5/6: Redwood smoke tests run; provide preliminary numbers.
- Mon 5/10: Full automated eval complete; review sync.

Attaching a small sample payload file (attachment: sample_payloads.tar.gz - stub).

Regards,
--
Marcus Li
Head of ML Engineering | Pinebridge Robotics
marcus.li@pinebridge.ai

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Li <marcus.li@pinebridge.ai>, Elena Martinez <elena@pinebridge.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 06 May 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC onboarding roadmap, success criteria & weekly check-ins

Marcus — perfect, appreciate the upload and the clear timeline. Quick weekly nudge and checklist before the smoke runs this afternoon: 

Checklist (today / 5/6)
- [x] Pinebridge: S3 sample payloads uploaded & IAM shared.
- [ ] Pinebridge: Completed Network_Questionnaire.xlsx (we still need the outbound IP ranges).
- [x] Redwood: trial instance provisioned and API keys created (Ben).
- [ ] Redwood: schedule 30-min network troubleshooting slot if needed (Ava assigned).

What Redwood will deliver by EOD 5/6
- Smoke-test latency numbers (cold + warmed), basic quality snapshot on the labeled QA set, and a short runbook of any blocking issues found.

Quick asks for you:
- Can Marcus confirm the peak batch pattern (roughly: 40 requests/s peak with 60% bursts at 200-300 token windows)? If you can confirm, we’ll add that to the load test.
- Please return Network_Questionnaire.xlsx with outbound IP ranges and any proxy/egress constraints so we can validate connectivity before the full run on Mon 5/10.

If I don’t hear back on the questionnaire by 3pm PT, I’ll ping the engineering alias for a quick session. Otherwise see you at the kickoff tomorrow.

Thanks — short calendar with the kickoff and the post-eval sync now in your calendars.

--
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
